report.summary: Both failures have one cause. The app's year validation in `app/main.py:83` has an off-by-one error and accepts next year. Fix the upper bound first. The API and UI tests should then pass without changes.

causes.title: Year validation accepts next year (this_year + 1)
causes.explanation: The validation allows years up to this_year + 1. The error message says the range ends at this_year, and the tests expect next year to be rejected. The API therefore returns 201 instead of 422. The UI form path saves the book and shows no error. The aria snapshot shows the row 'Future... 2027' was added. Both tests fail every time and the tests are correct.
evidence: app/main.py:84: raise HTTPException(422, f"Year must be between 1 and {this_year}")
UI aria snapshot shows row 'Future-5856a016 Someone 2027 Delete' and no error element
causes.suggested_fix: Change the check in app/main.py:83 to `1 <= book.year <= this_year`. The message already says this_year.
